answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a Verkle-tree polynomial commitment over its staked archival state, so a fresh Sybil must reproduce the full witness chain rather than a fable of past tenure. Stateless clients gossip a compact commitment-opening signal at the wharf of each epoch boundary, letting peers verify provenance in O(1) bandwidth without pruning history. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
